fields.acceptance: A checks step whose change-set fixer fails its first attempt and passes its second starts no new cycle: the retry runs inside the same cycle, and that cycle's checks start only after the fixer passes
fields.statement: A failed review fixer is retried within its cycle, and the cycle's checks start again only once its fixers pass

fields.acceptance: A checks step whose change-set fixer fails all 1 + MaxFixCycles attempts of a cycle ends that cycle's checks failed with the detail 'cycle N: fix failed', counts the cycle against MaxFixCycles, and starts no further check session in it
fields.statement: A review fixer that fails every retry spends its cycle, and the cycle's checks fail with the fix-failed detail
